name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Growth Marketing | Lifecycle Nurture, Scoring & Signals, AI Workflows & GEO
summary: Growth marketer who builds the machine instead of running someone else's. I build cohort-based nurture journeys, lead scoring, and lifecycle stages in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, pull and shape the data myself, and connect it all with agentic workflows that call the OpenAI and Claude APIs in n8n, Make, and Zapier. I've built a 9-dimension framework for how AI search and LLMs read and cite a business, and published 10 articles on it. A decade in B2B SaaS sales means I build warming motions that hand reps leads they actually want.

Define lifecycle stages and lead scoring, build reusable campaign templates, and track funnel results in GA4, Power BI, and SQL.
